[tab]      [ch]D[/ch]                                 [ch]Bm[/ch]
I was born on this mountain a long time ago [/tab]
[tab]            [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]               [ch]Bm[/ch]
Before they knocked down the timber and strip-mined the coal [/tab]
[tab]         [ch]D[/ch]                                 [ch]Bm[/ch]
When you rose in the mornin' before it was light [/tab]
[tab]      [ch]D[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]          [ch]Bm[/ch]    [ch]A[/ch]
To go down in that dark hole and come back up at night[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab]      [ch]D[/ch]                                         [ch]Bm[/ch] 
I was born on this mountain, this mountain's my home [/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]A[/ch]

[tab]         [ch]D[/ch]           [ch]Em[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]
